preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access mint(), freezeTransfers(), unfreezeTransfers() functions

exploit_hint: This finding is a gas optimization recommendation, not a security vulnerability. The functions mint(), freezeTransfers(), unfreezeTransfers() are protected by onlyOwner modifier, and transfer()/transferFrom() are protected by onlyUnfreeze modifier. No actual exploit exists - this is a code quality suggestion to change public functions to external for gas savings. To verify the contract logic: 1) Check owner() to identify the owner address, 2) Verify frozen state is false for transfers to work, 3) Note that changing public to external has no security impact, only gas optimization benefits.
